summary: Genuine counter-evidence attempts made for all four target claims. (1) SCoRe's 7B-beats-72B-teacher result: no independent replication or SCoRe-specific critique found despite citation-graph and distillation-artifact-literature searches; the closest finding is a general (ACL 2026, independent-authors) critique arguing agent distillation broadly can produce behavioral mimicry that inflates apparent capability without independent verification, but it does not engage SCoRe's own benchmarks or numbers -- low-moderate confidence (0.25), absence of direct replication is itself the key finding. (2) ACM's 'sub-9B models lose coherence' claim: partial, domain-mismatched counter-evidence found (ATOD, fetched in full, shows a 0.6B model succeeding on multi-turn ALFWorld/WebShop at >80%), but a stronger-methodology small-model-coherence source found in the same search (LHC v0.2, a blog benchmark) actually reinforces rather than contradicts the original claim at nearby (8B) scale -- confidence 0.3, mixed result reported plainly. (3) HORIZON's 'scaling alone unlikely to resolve' claim: strong, small-model-inclusive, peer-reviewed counter-evidence found on both requested angles -- 'Illusion of Diminishing Returns' (ICLR 2026) shows a clear scaling trend in long-horizon execution capability across 4B-frontier models even with comparable single-step accuracy, and AgentFloor (16 open-weight models, 0.27B-32B) shows small-model long-horizon failure signatures differ qualitatively from frontier ones in a capacity-flavored way, plus no intervention generalized across scales -- confidence 0.6, the strongest counter-claim of the four. (4) AgenticQwen/ATOD/CacheRL cluster: ATOD successfully upgraded from search-summary to fully-fetched-and-verified (strengthens the cluster rather than weakening it); CacheRL could not be upgraded despite two independent fetch attempts (remains unverifiable beyond search-summary); no independent third-party evaluation of AgenticQwen-8B was found on any external leaderboard -- confidence 0.3, corroboration-strength finding rather than direct contradiction. All four claims received a genuine, specific, good-faith counter-evidence search per the plan's search angles and constraints; no target claim was unfalsifiable or unworkable as scoped.
